annotation: Test-author expectations from explicit synthetic company/provider evidence; not a real-world accuracy dataset or independent human audit.

multi_constraint_match.label: MATCH
multi_constraint_match.reason: US HQ, declared 11–50 band, dated equity funding and a dated Account Executive posting.

size_disjoint.label: NON_MATCH
size_disjoint.reason: Verified declared band 201–500 is disjoint from 11–50.

hiring_unknown.label: UNKNOWN
hiring_unknown.reason: No dated matching employer posting; an empty search does not prove no hiring.

interrupted_funding_adoption.label: MATCH
interrupted_funding_adoption.reason: Same US/band mission without hiring; adopted fallback has dated equity funding.

spending_cap.label: MATCH
spending_cap.reason: Synthetic evidence would satisfy all requirements, but the spending limit prevents obtaining hiring proof. Expected unresolved, not rejection.

geography_disjoint.label: NON_MATCH
geography_disjoint.reason: Verified Toronto, Canada HQ fails hard US geography.

size_partial_overlap.label: UNKNOWN
size_partial_overlap.reason: Declared 51–200 only partly overlaps requested 11–100; no exact staff count is known.

size_member_count_only.label: UNKNOWN
size_member_count_only.reason: 30 associated LinkedIn members is not exact staff headcount; declared band missing.

size_exact_requirement.label: UNKNOWN
size_exact_requirement.reason: No catalogued source proves exactly 30 employees; existing feasibility preflight must refuse before execution.

funding_partial.label: UNKNOWN
funding_partial.reason: Round stage without an announcement date cannot prove funding within the requested window.

hiring_stale.label: UNKNOWN
hiring_stale.reason: Posting dated 2025-01-01 is outside the 30-day window at the frozen observation date.

zero_results.reason: No company discovered; no company truth label exists.

industry_supported.label: MATCH
industry_supported.reason: Explicit subscription software product, business customers and sales-pipeline activity support the recorded synthetic grounded classification.

industry_unknown.label: UNKNOWN
industry_unknown.reason: Broad Software Development category plus vague description does not establish the business model.

industry_non_match.label: NON_MATCH
industry_non_match.reason: Explicit staffing agency delivering recruiting services to business clients, despite a broad software category.
